notes: ~72 candidates investigated; 47 included, 8 rejected. 6 NEW subcategories proposed: 'CI/CD and build automation', 'Monitoring, logging and status pages', 'DNS hosting and edge networking', 'Workflow automation and scheduling', 'Data visualization, BI and dashboarding' (Programming), 'Scientific computing and plotting' (Education). Cross-agent dupes to resolve: DuckDNS + healthchecks.io also proposed by web-file-utilities under an existing Website sub — prefer the existing sub. Near-duplicate functional overlaps flagged honestly in notes: Gitea/Forgejo, gitui/lazygit, TruffleHog/Gitleaks, Dokku/Coolify, SigNoz/Sentry. healthchecks.io and DuckDNS were also proposed by the web-file-utilities agent under the existing Uptime monitoring, DNS and domains subsection; that placement won the cross-agent dedupe.
